configurations.label: A
configurations.description: All experts CPU (-cmoe), dense layers GPU (-ngl 48)

memory_classification_notes.virtual_mapping: mmap maps entire 18.63 GB GGUF into process virtual address space.
memory_classification_notes.prefetch_request: llama.cpp calls PrefetchVirtualMemory on load as an advisory hint. Windows may fulfill partially or reject under memory pressure.
memory_classification_notes.resident_working_set: Only actively executed expert pages (approx 862.6 MiB for 8 active experts in Config D) plus cached pages stay in physical RAM.
memory_classification_notes.cached_file_backed_pages: Model pages in physical RAM are clean file-backed cache pages dropped without pagefile writes when OS needs RAM.
memory_classification_notes.private_committed_memory: Only process runtime heap, stack, tokenizer, and metadata (~400 MB) are private anonymous commit.
memory_classification_notes.cuda_allocations: GPU dense layers, GPU expert layers, KV cache, and compute buffers are allocated in dedicated VRAM.
